name: Tic Tac Toe
description: A polished browser-based Tic Tac Toe game for two local players, focused on clear gameplay, responsive layout, and deterministic game-state logic.
additional_tech: Testing Library for component interaction tests
CSS modules or plain CSS for styling
architecture_style: client-side single page app with separated game logic and UI components
conventions: Keep winner/draw/turn calculation in pure TypeScript functions, not inside React render code
Represent the board as a fixed 9-cell array with values X, O, or null
Use accessible buttons for board cells with clear aria labels
Prevent moves after a win or draw until the player starts a new game
Keep visual state derived from game state instead of duplicating status flags
Use deterministic tests for win detection, draw detection, turn switching, invalid moves, and reset behavior
Use responsive CSS so the board works cleanly on mobile and desktop
deployment: static web app deployable from the Vite production build
infra_constraints: No database, persistence layer, authentication, or external game service
The app must run locally with npm-compatible package scripts
The production build must emit static assets only
nfrs: Initial screen shows an empty 3x3 board, current player, and reset/new game control
Players alternate X then O by clicking empty cells
The game detects all row, column, and diagonal wins immediately after a move
The game detects a draw when the board is full and no player has won
The UI remains usable at common mobile widths without text overlap
Game state resets without requiring a page reload
No network access is needed at runtime
forbidden: No database or browser storage for the initial version
No AI opponent unless explicitly requested in a later story
No canvas-only implementation - use semantic HTML controls for the board
